integrity.earlier_background_date: Gini mean difference paper appeared in 2003 but an exact initial public day was not verified; the dated arXiv lead is 2013-02-21.
integrity.result_proved_by: self-contained analytic argument, supplemented with exact integer finite tests
integrity.verification_limit: Finite enumerations are corroboration, not an all-n proof

scientific_limitations: Finite real cyclic signals with n>=3; periodic equal-weight nearest-neighbor-plus-self averaging only.
The theorem concerns one averaging step, unweighted complete-pair Gini variation, and does not supply a full unequal-tap classification.
Historical priority remains provisional, particularly for unindexed rearrangement literature.
title: Sharp Gini contraction and level-count variance for cyclic three-point averaging
